update.title: Collected artifacts created during Work Report sessions
update.summary: Made report completion find artifacts created during the active session and added a direct attachment path for evidence added afterward.

blocks.body:
## Collect evidence created during the session

Artifacts registered while answering report questions exist independently from the active report. At completion, Work Report searches the bounded session window and adds newly created artifacts to the candidate set, so callers do not have to carry identifiers through every tool call.

blocks.code:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A as Agent
  participant W as Work Report
  participant R as Artifact registry
  A->>R: Register artifact
  A->>W: Complete report
  W->>R: Search session window
  R-->>W: New candidates
  W->>W: Attach reviewed evidence
blocks.description: An agent registers an artifact independently, and Work Report discovers it during completion before attaching reviewed evidence. Completion searches the active session window and brings newly registered evidence back into the report.

blocks.body:
## Attach evidence after creation

Existing reports gained a direct attachment path for one or more files, making missed or newly generated evidence recoverable without reopening the guided flow. The automation command builder also removes an optional flag together with its empty value, keeping attachment calls valid when other edit fields are omitted.
